reason: My notes live in Apple Notes and Google Docs, they already sync between my phone and laptop, and I can already snap a whiteboard into a note. I might poke at the free tier once, but I'm not paying $6 a month to rebuild a setup that already works.
objection: Moving years of notes over sounds like a weekend of work, and I'd be betting that a brand-new app will still be around in two years. If it folds, my stuff is stuck in someone else's format.
would_change_my_mind: A one-tap import of my existing Notes and Google Docs that sorts them into folders for me, plus an easy full export so I'm never locked in.
